corrective_action: High-temperature laser spike thermal re-anneal attempting mask stress relaxation without stage recalibration.
telemetry_status: Verified post-rework KLA SEM defect scan and wafer probe log.
engineering_finding: Although laser spike heating shifted EUV overlay to 0.95 nm, excessive thermal excursion ruptured dielectric spacers in Metal-1 routing and caused 14 interconnect bridge short circuits per die against a strict limit of 0 shorts.
